segformer_b0_identity.library: transformers/timm (identity to be bound at EXT-03 implementation)

common_recipe.augmentation: same augmentation family for all trainable baselines

seed_policy: common prospective seed set for all trainable comparators; report per-seed and mean; never change seeds from results
checkpoint_selection: INTERNAL development-validation only; never external / ROUTER_HOLDOUT / TEST / Phase39 TEST / external benchmark
fairness: all trainable baselines receive the same internal TRAIN authority, dev-validation authority, resolution, augmentation family, seed count, loss family, optimizer/scheduler policy, max budget, early-stopping opportunity, checkpoint criterion unless architecture-specific differences are unavoidable and prospectively documented
no_external_use: no external image or GT may participate in training/validation/checkpoint selection/early stopping/hyperparameter choice

authority_binding.note: recipe values are bound to existing frozen internal baseline authorities where they exist (configs/phase09_clean_v3, configs/phase10_clean_v3, scripts/training/train_phase10_baselines.py); any value not present in an authority is a prospective EXT-02.1 choice
